Bachstrasse PV recognition regression image
=========================================
SWISSIMAGE aerial imagery, copyright swisstopo; retrieved through the app's
map capture for Bachstrasse 15, 5000 Aarau (47.390263, 8.047975), 2026-09-11.
The 1280 x 988 capture is kept at inference resolution. Reviewed positive
points cover narrow PV rows previously missed by the single orientation;
negative points cover shade, machinery, an opening and bare roof.
These are regression probes, not a complete labelled mask or accuracy score.
